scripts.check: bun x --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.check.json && bun x --bun tsc --noEmit -p db/tsconfig.json && bun x --bun tsc --noEmit -p codegen/tsconfig.json && bun x --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.api-tools.json
scripts.quality: bun run lint && bun run check
scripts.test: bun test ops/tests tests codegen/tests db --dots --path-ignore-patterns '**/*.integration.test.ts' --preload ../../tooling/test-support/unit-preload.ts
scripts.lint: bun x --bun eslint . && cd codegen && bun x --bun eslint src tests bin
scripts.lint:fix: bun x --bun eslint . --fix && cd codegen && bun x --bun eslint src tests bin --fix
